components.surface: Provider-returned cancellation classification now accepts error/reason values cancelled and timeout in addition to aborted, AbortError, and ABORT_ERR; recursive content[].text JSON parsing remains active.
createWorkflowStopSignal pollMs default changes from 50ms to 200ms and minimum clamp from 10ms to 1ms; timer polling and immediate check remain the execution path.
Public summary property launchRetryAttempts is renamed to launchRetries; value still sums task.launchRetry.attempts across all tasks.
SPEC.md documents the previous poll defaults and previous launchRetryAttempts contract. package.json exposes only npm run typecheck, has no build/test script, no exports field, and is private.
